thread:
maria (PM): Quick sync — we need to finalize the production clearance decision tree + prompt-contract acceptance criteria before next week's cutover. Can folks call out ownership for SLA / docs / support / monitoring / pricing?
aj (eng): I can own SLA latency/throughput gating. proposal: p50/p95 targets + a 3-tier degradation plan.
kevin (oncall): I’ll own oncall runbooks and alert routing. need explicit paging thresholds and rollback triggers.
sophie (product ops): I'll map customer slices and what 'green' looks like per slice (enterprise vs free). also will own commercial acceptance checklist.
maria (PM): Awesome — can we list the minimal artifact for each gate? e.g., SLA -> latency report + perf runbook, Docs -> quickstart + troubleshooting, Support -> triage playbook + SLOs, Monitoring -> dashboards + synthetic checks, Pricing -> unit economics + quota plan.
tilly (docs): I can ship the quickstart and one-pager, but need example requests and common failure patterns from eng by EOD Friday.
aj (eng): copying minimal artifacts:
```
- perf-run: 1k sample traffic across slices
- p50/p95/p99 token latency
- cost-per-token calc
- failure-mode matrix (OOM, network, degraded-model)
```
aj (eng): also propose a simple decision tree for clearance:
1) automated perf tests pass -> 2) canary w/ 1% traffic for 24h -> 3) smoke + alert verification -> 4) full ramp. if any gate fails, auto-fallback to smaller model.
sophie (product ops): add a commercial 'stoplight' check: contract clauses, SLA exceptions, billing hook tested.
kevin (oncall): alert thresholds: p95 > target for 10m -> P1 page. error-rate > 1% for 5m -> P1. synthetic check failure -> P0 (immediate). I'll draft exact Prometheus rules.
maria (PM): who owns the final signoff from legal/commercial for any SLA exceptions?
sophie (product ops): I'll coordinate legal signoff; need list of exception scenarios.
tilly (docs): aj — can you paste sample error logs or a reproducible failure snippet? makes docs faster.
aj (eng): will add a small `curl` example that simulates large context before EOD.
maria (PM): decision needed: do we require price-quoting tool to be live before prod clearance or is a manual backstop acceptable for week-1?
sophie (product ops): manual backstop OK for week-1 if we commit to automation in 2 weeks and customers are notified. we should mark that in the rollout playbook.
kevin (oncall): ensure quota cutover won't generate storm of 429s that loop clients. include client-retry guidance in docs.
tilly (docs): noted — will add retry guidance and example SDK config.
aj (eng): one more engineering constraint: KV cache priming needs a warmup period; canary should include warmup traffic to avoid cold-start regressions.
maria (PM): timeline check: artifacts in place by Fri EOD -> small canary Mon -> full ramp Wed if no blockers. sound realistic?
sophie (product ops): sounds good. I'll prepare the customer slice matrix and commercial stoplight by Fri.
kevin (oncall): I'll have alert rules + a short paging playbook by Fri as well.
tilly (docs): quickstart + failures one-pager will be ready. will send draft link.
aj (eng): perf run queued; will share raw numbers and the failure-mode matrix here when done.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy for project/redwood-inference on 1742170000. status: pending.
maria (PM): perfect — next steps: owners to drop artifacts into the GA-readiness folder, tag me, and we'll run a short review on Monday. thanks all :thumbsup:
